question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a red present, Dave has a yellow present, Eve has a silver present, Fred has a grey present, and Gertrude has a blue present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) teal present
(C) red present
(D) yellow present
(E) silver present
(F) grey present
(G) blue present
solution:
Gift colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (black, teal, red, yellow, silver, grey, blue)
1. Claire ↔ Fred: (black, teal, grey, yellow, silver, red, blue)
2. Fred ↔ Dave: (black, teal, grey, red, silver, yellow, blue)
3. Alice ↔ Claire: (grey, teal, black, red, silver, yellow, blue)
4. Fred ↔ Alice: (yellow, teal, black, red, silver, grey, blue)
5. Eve ↔ Bob: (yellow, silver, black, red, teal, grey, blue)
6. Dave ↔ Eve: (yellow, silver, black, teal, red, grey, blue)
7. Fred ↔ Bob: (yellow, grey, black, teal, red, silver, blue)
Bob has the grey present, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
